about: The host budget (WS4a): each row is one of the model's mutants (models/gatebudget) ported to the implementation.

mutants.name: budget-admit-by-count
mutants.from: func (s *State) Fits(r Rules, e Entry) bool { return s.Used()+e.Width <= r.Cores }
mutants.to: func (s *State) Fits(r Rules, e Entry) bool { return len(s.Holders) < r.Cores }
mutants.rule: Admission is by cores: the widths held never sum past the budget.

mutants.name: budget-gate-all
mutants.from: func Gated(r Rules, e Entry) bool { return r.High && !e.Crit }
mutants.to: func Gated(r Rules, e Entry) bool { return r.High }
mutants.rule: The interim load gate stops only the lane class; crit is never gated.

mutants.name: budget-newest-first
mutants.rule: The hand-on serves the oldest waiter of a class: no take passes an older waiter of its own class.

mutants.name: budget-release-hands-nothing
mutants.from:
s.Waiters = slices.DeleteFunc(s.Waiters, func(e Entry) bool { return e.ID == id })
	return s.Admit(r)
mutants.to:
s.Waiters = slices.DeleteFunc(s.Waiters, func(e Entry) bool { return e.ID == id })
	return nil
mutants.rule: A release hands the freed cores on in the same step: no waiter waits while it fits.

mutants.name: budget-store-admit-by-count
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4a (model ByCount, in the store)
mutants.from: return Rules{Cores: b.cfg.Cores, Share: b.cfg.Share, High: high}
mutants.to: return Rules{Cores: 2 * b.cfg.Cores, Share: b.cfg.Share, High: high}
mutants.rule: The store decides with the host owner's budget, not a larger one.

mutants.name: budget-watch-never-wakes
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4a (model Poll, in the store)
mutants.rule: An entry's end (a release or a crash) wakes the waiters, so they take the freed cores.

mutants.name: budget-dead-entry-alive
mutants.rule: A crash frees its cores: an entry whose lock the kernel dropped is pruned.

mutants.name: budget-lend-ignored
mutants.rule: A child runs in its parent's lent grant and never queues for the budget.

mutants.name: budget-gated-head-blocks
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4a (model GatedHead; the live bug of 2026-11-20)
mutants.rule: A gated lane waiter is never next: a crit waiter behind it is served at once while cores are free.

mutants.name: budget-lend-wider-queues
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4a (model ChildQueues, a child wider than its grant)
mutants.rule: A child wider than its parent's grant runs in the grant at the grant's width and never queues.

mutants.name: budget-run-leaves-group
mutants.rule: Run kills what its command left running in its process group.
